Serving Omaha Metro

Let's be honest, sometimes a yard gets away from you. One minute it's manageable, and the next—after a wild Nebraska storm, a busy season at work, or just life happening—you're looking at a space that feels more like a jungle than a backyard. It’s not just about aesthetics; an overgrown, messy yard can be a headache and even a hazard. That's where we come in.

My name is Bryan, and at A1, we do more than just basic lawn care. Our yard cleanup service is the total reset button for your property. We’ve seen it all in neighborhoods from Dundee to Elkhorn, and we know how to bring a yard back from the brink. Whether you've got fallen limbs from a thunderstorm, years of accumulated leaves, or just a tangled mess of weeds and overgrowth, we have the crew and the equipment to tackle it efficiently.

From Overwhelmed to Outstanding: Your Yard Reset

A major yard cleanup is about more than just making things look tidy. It’s about reclaiming your outdoor space so you can actually enjoy it. It’s about getting rid of the clutter that can attract pests and making sure your property is safe for kids and pets to run around in. We take a comprehensive approach, looking at the entire yard to see what needs to go and what can be saved.

What a Full Yard Cleanup Includes

When we say full cleanup, we mean it. We’re not just doing a quick pass with a rake. We’re equipped to handle the tough stuff and get your yard back into a manageable state. If you have specific shrubs or hedges that need detailed work, our shrub & hedge trimming service can be a great next step.

Debris & Leaf Removal

We'll clear out all the accumulated leaves, branches, twigs, and other organic debris cluttering your lawn and flower beds.

Clearing Overgrowth & Weeds

Tackling overgrown vegetation and thick patches of weeds that have taken over parts of your yard.

Hauling Away All Waste

It’s not clean until the mess is gone. Our complete yard waste removal service means we load it all up and haul it away for you.

General Tidying

This includes getting into corners, along fence lines, and around structures to make the entire property look sharp.

Why Bother With a Professional Cleanup?

You could spend multiple weekends trying to get your yard under control, making trip after trip to dispose of the waste. Or, you could make one call and let us knock it out in a fraction of the time. We have the right equipment, the right size crew, and the experience to work quickly and thoroughly. For us, it’s a standard process. For you, it’s getting your free time back and a yard you can be proud of without all the back-breaking work.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is this different from your seasonal cleanup service?

Yes, it can be. While our seasonal cleanups are typically for spring and fall prep, a general yard cleanup can happen anytime. It's for when things have just gotten out of hand due to a storm, neglect, or a property you've recently taken over.

Do you haul away the debris and junk?

Absolutely. We're A1 Junk Removal and Tree Service, so hauling is in our DNA. We won't leave a pile on your curb; all cleared debris and waste is loaded up and properly disposed of as part of the job.

What if I have old furniture or a hot tub that needs to go, too?

We can take care of that at the same time. Just let us know when you call for an estimate. We can bundle our junk removal services with the yard cleanup to save you a headache.

How much does a full yard cleanup in Omaha cost?

The cost really depends on the size of your yard and the amount of work needed. A small yard with just leaves and a few branches will be much different than an acre that's completely overgrown. The best way to know for sure is to have us out for a free, no-obligation estimate.
